editorial:
Imagine having the worst day of your life, fighting with your bank on the phone, and then realizing the dead body in your van might actually be alive. That is exactly where you land with this wild comedy. You follow a mortuary driver who is just trying to get through his shift, but things go south fast when he starts hearing noises from the back. The vibe is a mix of nervous energy and dark humor, making you feel the stress of the driver while you laugh at how bad his luck is. It is a small-scale story that feels big because of how much tension is packed into that van.

You will love how the movie keeps you guessing with a pace that never really lets up. The acting is great, especially the way the lead handles the panic. While some of the jokes might feel a bit silly, the twists make it worth the ride. If you are in the mood for something quirky and fast, you should definitely check it out.
endingExplained: In the end, you find out the person in the back was not actually dead but was in a deep coma or state of shock. After a series of chaotic events and near-misses, the driver manages to get the person help just in time. The twist is that the medical mistake happened because of a clerical error. Everything wraps up with the driver finally getting some peace and the passenger waking up to a very confusing situation.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark humor and stories about people in awkward situations.
